remarks: Classic center hall Colonial home located in central Wilton which offers all the amenities. This 4 bedroom 3 bath home is spacious and has a functional layout for modern day living. The updated kitchen has stainless steel appliances, granite counters and is conveniently located just a few steps away from the family room with 9ft+ ceiling, fireplace, french doors to private deck and backyard plus a built-in desk area, ideal for a home office. The living room with large picture window and fireplace, opens to the dining room which has french doors to the oversized screened in porch. Upstairs you will find the primary bedroom with full bath with plenty of closet space including a walk-in closet with built-in dressers. 3 additional bedrooms and full bath complete the second floor. Other features of the home include a mudroom, central air, hardwood floors throughout, two car attached garage and large lower level ready to be finished! The spacious backyard is peaceful and private! Wilton's Treasured Ambler Farm and Rolling Hills CC are within walking distance. This home awaits its next owner.
